[[Securing the Vale]] is a [[quest]] during which [[Van the Warrior]] asks the [[player]] to investigate three patrol points in [[Traveler's Vale]] to ensure the safe passage of [[Ascalonian]]s.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = warrior
}}

===Objectives===
*Proceed to the first patrol point in Traveler's Vale.
*Proceed to the second patrol point in Traveler's Vale.
*Proceed to the third patrol point in Traveler's Vale.
*Return to Van the Warrior for your reward.

===Reward===
*500 [[Experience]]
*100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
*{{skill icon|Swift Chop}}
*{{skill icon|Irresistible Blow}}
*{{skill icon|Seeking Blade}}

==Walkthrough==
Proceed to each patrol point, potentially clearing enemies along the way to avoid [[aggro|overaggro]]. Once all three points have been visited, return to Van the Warrior.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Van the Warrior
:''"Looking for a way to serve Ascalon? I have just the task for you, <Character name>. We knew these [[Shiverpeak Mountains|mountains]] were treacherous when we headed here… Even without these [[Stone Summit]] challenging us, we'd have our hands full with the [[Centaur]]s and [[ettin]]s. I need strong men and women to help me secure the Vale. If you think you're up to the challenge, I've laid out several '''patrol points''' that I need investigated. All you need to do is follow these points and then return to me to report any enemy activity you encounter.''

:''You think you can handle that?"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'm on it.
| decline = I have better things to do.
| ask = Simply proceed to each '''patrol point''' in turn, and then report back to me with your findings.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Van the Warrior
:''"By [[Balthazar]]'s blade! I had hoped for less resistance, but you did well to overcome such [[foe]]s. I am going to have to speak with [[Captain Osric|Osric]] and see if we can spare more warriors to secure the area. Here's a little something for your trouble."''

==Notes==
*Despite the warning of enemy encounters, there is no need to fight any [[target]]s during this quest, and no additional enemies are spawned.
**Because of this, the quest combines well with other quests in Traveler's Vale, particularly [[Shiverpeak Stragglers]], [[The Way is Blocked]], and [[The Road to Borlis Pass]].
*It is possible to start from [[Borlis Pass (outpost)|Borlis Pass]] and complete the objective for the second patrol point before the first.
*It is impossible to complete the third patrol point objective prior to the other two.
*It is possible to encounter [[Devona]] near the third patrol point. She will be running into the Vale from the [[Ascalon Foothills]] and engage in combat throughout the [[Explorable area|area]]. There is no need to keep her alive or assist her during this quest.
